title: MPH Hall Usage for Chathurthi Event Practice
summary: Air conditioning will be available daily from 6:00 PM to 8:00 PM until 18 September for your convenience. At all other times, the hall is available without AC.
body:
Dear Residents,

We are happy to see so many of you enthusiastically participating in the Chathurthi event and practising for it.

To make your practice sessions more comfortable, we have decided to turn on the AC daily between 6:00 PM and 8:00 PM until 18th of September. Kindly plan your practice sessions accordingly.

You may also use the MPH at any other time without air conditioning.

Thanks,
TOA.
